check_semantics.signature: check({action_id, actor:{capacity, seat_active, recused, delegation_active, acting_for?}, object:{events?, actor_relations?, approvals?, <object_conditions keys>}, purpose: EXECUTE|DRAFT, manual_operation?}) -> {result: ALLOWED|DENIED|SOURCE_REQUIRED, code, reason}
order: 2. no capacity -> DENIED; capacity in admin_capacities_never_case_actors -> DENIED (PROT-§21)
3. seat capacities (seat_capacities) need seat_active === true; any other capacity except SYSTEM is DENIED when seat_active === false (assignment ended)
4. actor.recused === true -> DENIED (a recused seat may only be 'informed' by non-content notices)
5. object.actor_relations intersects excluded_relations -> DENIED (IMPORTER, PREPARER, CONFLICT_RAISER, CONFLICT_SUBJECT, REQUESTER)

6. role: capacity in executor | decision_maker | approver (purpose DRAFT also accepts preparer); a delegate (delegation.to) counts only when delegation.allowed, actor.delegation_active === true and actor.acting_for is in delegation.acting_for and holds a role; else DENIED (INFORMED_ONLY or NO_ROLE)
7. governing_source.status SOURCE_REQUIRED (or DRAFT) -> SOURCE_REQUIRED; purpose DRAFT with manual_operation === true -> ALLOWED (code SOURCE_REQUIRED_DRAFT, label MANUAL_OPERATION)
8. conditional_source_required entry whose 'when' holds -> SOURCE_REQUIRED (same DRAFT exception)
9. purpose EXECUTE: every preconditions[].event_type recorded in object.events, else DENIED (PRECONDITION_MISSING)
10. purpose EXECUTE: an event in expires_on_events recorded -> DENIED (EXPIRED)
11. purpose EXECUTE: object_conditions + capacity_preconditions[capacity] must hold, else DENIED (OBJECT_CONDITION)

12. purpose EXECUTE: approval_required with approval.applies_to BEFORE_EXECUTION, or a conditional_approvals entry whose 'when' holds -> object.approvals must contain one of the approver capacities, else DENIED (APPROVAL_MISSING, PC-08)
check_semantics.fail_closed: an object condition whose key is missing does not hold (DENIED); a conditional 'when' whose key is missing HOLDS unless a known value contradicts it, so the stricter path applies
check_semantics.outside_platform: DECIDE has platform.status OUTSIDE_PLATFORM: check() answers whether the capacity holds the right (the next action of the competent authority); the act is performed on the signed artefact and enters the platform only through RECORD_AUTHORITY_DECISION
check_semantics.w_d2_alignment: action ids SEND_MEETING_INVITATION, SEND_INFO_REQUEST, ACKNOWLEDGE_REFERRAL, REVIEW_MINUTES, SUBMIT_STATEMENT, FILE_GRIEVANCE, GIVE_WITNESS_STATEMENT, SUBMIT_EVIDENCE, VIEW_PUBLIC_STATUS match the consumer's provisional ids so that no provisional action or status is supplemented; steps 5, 8, 11 and 12 extend the consumer's order and are exercised by the AUT tests marked in 'tests' (reference_result computed by the generator's reference implementation)
check_semantics.parameters_source_required: listed per action for review; they never change check() but mark values (periods, recipients, criteria) that have no source and must render as SOURCE_REQUIRED

separation: administrative:true = coordination (scheduling, inviting, issuing, recording, dispatching); administrative:false = formal decision-making (opening/closing votes, adopting, approving, deciding, recusing, conflict decisions). Issuing a decision notice never equals the decision; recording an authority decision never equals deciding.
